frase: Today I want to thank you for everything you gave me, mom, and thank God for giving me a mother like you.
It has always been said that there is only one mother, but it doesn't make sense until you miss her.
When a mother leaves, a part of you goes with her, because there is nothing comparable to a mother.
It has been a while since I saw you with my eyes, but in my mind and in my heart you are just as present as always.
Mom, you must be proud of the family you have built, just as we are proud of you.
You will never know the value of a mother until all you have left is her memory.
You passed like a shooting star in our lives, but your light will shine forever in our hearts.
Mom, you are an angel of love and kindness who will never die; your memory is with us every day of our lives.
Mom, you are and always will be the best part of me. Thank you for making me the person I am.
You have been a wonderful mother and an unsurpassable grandmother. Thank you for giving us all your love.
Mom, you are the hand that holds me and the light that illuminates me; never stop guiding me.
The world changes from year to year, our lives from day to day, but the love and memory of you will never pass away.
Grief and love go together, you cannot get one without the other. All I can do is love her, and love the world, emulate her by living with audacity, spirit, and joy.
Every time I miss you, I also remember how fortunate I was to have you in my life. I wouldn't trade those moments for anything in the world.
If I had a flower for every time I think of you… I could walk in my garden forever.
One does not go around grieving all the time, but the sorrow is still there and always will be.
Grief can be a burden, but also an anchor. You get used to the weight, to how it holds you.
We understand death only after it has placed its hands on someone we love.
Perhaps they are not stars in the sky, but openings where our loved ones shine to let us know they are happy.
Sometimes, only one person is missing, and the whole world seems depopulated.
Love as powerful as your mother's for you leaves its own mark. To have been loved so deeply, even though the person who loved us is gone, will give us some protection forever.
There is something about the loss of a mother that is permanent and inexpressible: a wound that will never fully heal.
Her absence is like the sky, spreading over everything.
Hold on to your parents because it is a scary and confusing world without them.

I miss the warmth of your gentle embrace and the love I felt when my arms wrapped around you. I miss seeing your beautiful smile and the sound of your voice saying my name. I miss hearing you say "I love you" and me saying "I love you" back.
All that I am, or hope to be, I owe to my angel mother.

Mothers never really die, they just keep house in the sky. They polish the sun by day and light the stars that shine at night, they keep the moonbeams silver, and in the heavenly home above they wait to welcome the ones they love.

Mom, today I miss you, but I know you will always be with me in my heart… I am who I am thanks to your loving hands. I have my sweet and compassionate soul from having seen you and your generosity and kindness to others. I see the world full of wonder thanks to your imagination. I have learned to never give up by seeing your drive and perseverance… I love you always and forever…

A mother's love is always with her children. Losing a mother is one of the deepest sorrows a heart can know. But her kindness, her warmth, and her wisdom live on, like a legacy of love that will always be with you. May that love surround you now and bring you peace.
You were my home, mother. I had no home other than you.
'Death does not exist, my child. People only die when we forget them,' my mother explained to me shortly before leaving me. 'If you remember me, I will be with you always.'
No matter how prepared you think you are for the death of a loved one, it is still a shock, and it still hurts very deeply.
I wish I had the power to take back all the pain, worry, and harm I caused you. I wish I could undo all the moments that made you sad. I miss you, mom.
I cannot forget my mother. She is my bridge. When I needed to cross, she held firm long enough for me to cross safely.
What we have once deeply enjoyed we can never lose. All that we love deeply becomes a part of us.
I should know enough about loss to realize that you never stop missing someone, you just learn to live around the huge hole of their absence.
Tears shed for another person are not a sign of weakness. They are a sign of a pure heart.
My mother had a slender and small body, but a big heart: a heart so big that the joys of the whole world found welcome and hospitable room in it.
There are no goodbyes for us. Wherever you are, you will always be in my heart.
I miss saying 'mom' out loud. I miss not being able to find that special card for you and, after finding it, writing 'For Mom' on it for another cherished Mother's Day.
If the people we love are stolen from us, the way to keep them living is to never stop loving them.
Losing the people you love affects you. It buries itself inside you and becomes this big, deep hole of pain. It doesn't magically disappear, not even when you officially stop mourning.
My mother was the most beautiful woman I ever saw. All that I am I owe to my mother. I attribute my success in life to the moral, intellectual, and physical education I received from her.
My mother is an endless song in my heart of comfort, happiness, and being. I may sometimes forget the words, but I always remember the tune.

My mother… had a very deep inner spirituality that allowed her to rebuild her life. It is extraordinary that she had such a strong sense of self, such a commitment to the future, and such a strong creative sense that she could build new worlds for herself and for us out of the total devastation of her life.
Grief is like the ocean, it comes in waves that ebb and flow. Sometimes the water is calm and sometimes it is overwhelming. All we can do is learn to swim.
Tears are sacred. They are not the mark of weakness, but of power. They speak more eloquently than ten thousand tongues. They are messengers of overwhelming grief and unspeakable love.

I know for sure that we never lose the people we love, not even to death. They continue to participate in every act, thought, and decision we make. Their love leaves an indelible mark on our memory. We find comfort in knowing that our lives have been enriched by having shared their love.
Those we love and lose are always connected by heartstrings to infinity.
Heaven is celebrating because it has received a great woman: my mother!
You will never know the value of a mother until all you have left is her memory.
It has been a while since I saw you with my eyes, but in my mind and in my heart you are just as present as always.
Thank you, because whenever I needed a hand, you gave me three.
Mom, you are and always will be the best part of me. Thank you for making me the person I am.
I realized that when you look at your mother, you are looking at the purest love you will ever know.
Because there is only one mother, and you have been the best.
A mother's love is a love unlike any other. It cannot be compared to anything.
You have been a wonderful mother and an unsurpassable grandmother. Thank you for giving us all your love.
Mom, my heart calls out to you, does not forget you, and misses you; I hope to see you again.
Thank you, mom, for giving me what no one else ever can: your sincere love and unconditional support.
Mom, these flowers go up to heaven for you, who watch over me from up there.
Something left with you, something left on the wings of your soul or in your last breath that will never return, but we will meet again, mom.
There are many wonders in the universe; but the masterpiece of creation is the heart of a mother.
The sad flower of forgetfulness will never bloom on your grave, because God knows you have been a good mother and a faithful wife.
The fragrance of your flowers became a balm that calms the heart, and the warm month of June became transparent with your infinite presence.
Mom, your departure was unexpected and painful, but your memory will live in our hearts forever.
Blessed mother: you were love, sweetness, and comfort; you will live eternally in the hearts of your children.
Time can heal the anguish of the wounds you left, but the loss will never be repaired.
Being a mother means being present in the heart of the child wherever they are, and you will always be in ours.
We will never find a better, more selfless, or truer tenderness than that of a mother. Thank you, mom, for everything.
A mother's love is the fuel that enables a human being to achieve the impossible.
Knowing you are gone is hard, but I know you will be with the Lord on the path to eternal life. Don't forget how much we miss you.
Mom, without you my life would not have been possible. Thank you for every hug, every kiss, and every word of support. I love you.
Because there is only one mother, and you have been the best.
Without you, mom, nothing will be the same. You made us the happiest people in the world.
My mother is a queen who, despite so many falls, never dropped her crown.
Thank you for your patience and trust in us; we are who we are thanks to you.
To the world you are a mother, to us you are the world.
Thank you for being the light in dark moments, the hope in my bad times, and the courage when fear overcame me. I love you, Mom.
Thank you, Mom, for giving your life for me, for prioritizing my needs over yours, and for your unconditional love.
When I look at the sky, emotion fills me as I remember you. Watch over me from up there and wait for me, for one day we will embrace again.
I wouldn't have enough lifetime to thank you for everything you have done for me, but I promise I will never forget you; I will always keep you in mind.
I will never be able to forget the pain of your departure, but I will also never forget the wonderful experience of having had you in my life.
Thank you, Mom, for having been my guide in life, my role model, and my motivation to be who I am today.
Mom, I remember you and my soul fills with joy for everything you gave me while you were beside me. I will always remember you.
I hope I can be as good a mother as you were to me. I hope my children remember me as I remember you: as the best mother in the world.
I wish I had a staircase to heaven so I could hug you again, Mom.
I have asked heaven to tell you that I love you, since it can see you every day and I can only see you in my dreams.
Even if I don't cry for you, it hurts; even if I don't talk to you, I think of you; even if I don't look for you, I miss you. Mom, I still love you.
Mother, even though you are not by my side, I feel you very close; I will never forget you.
You left and a part of me went with you.
Your memory will live forever in my heart.
Thank you for loving me like no one else ever will.
My heart never forgets you.
I am who I am thanks to you.
Your absence is a pain that hits hard every day.
And suddenly the mind fills with memories and the eyes with tears.
I miss you, simple as that.
What remains inside your soul never leaves.
Stay in my memories, where nobody can touch you.
How could heaven not be beautiful?
I remember you every day of my life.
I don't see you, but in my heart you are just as present.
You gave me everything without expecting anything in return.
You would be proud of the woman I am thanks to you.
Your light will always shine in my heart.
Mom, you are and will be the best part of me.
You taught me the meaning of unconditional love.
I will treasure in my soul every minute you dedicated to me.
My mother's love is forever.
Remembering your laughter will always make me smile.
Your advice will always guide me.
It is an honor and a privilege to be your daughter.
I promise to be the best version of your love.
